films.desc_en: A high-energy vertical teaser showcasing the vibrant, intricate energy of automotive cable harnesses manufactured in North Macedonia.
films.music: Pounding electronic bass, fast hi-hats, aggressive synth pulses, 130 bpm
vo_mk: Иднината на возењето започнува од Македонија.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Extreme close-up of thick, premium copper wires twisting together into a main automotive cable harness. Bright neon blue and orange rim lighting against a dark industrial background. Highly detailed, photorealistic textures, metallic reflection, shallow depth of field, centered subject.
shots.motion: The copper wires slowly twist and intertwine continuously as the camera slowly pushes in towards the center.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A sleek, unbranded, white robotic arm holding a complex automotive cable harness in a pristine, brightly lit modern factory. The factory has large windows showing the Skopje skyline in the blurred background. Cool daylight, cinematic lighting, centered subject, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The robotic arm smoothly pans horizontally to showcase the cable harness, while the camera slowly tilts up.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A sleek, unbranded silver sports car driving along the winding road of Mount Vodno at twilight. The car's glowing LED taillights leave a subtle light trail. Deep blue hour sky, cinematic composition, centered subject, photorealistic, premium automotive look.
shots.motion: The silver car drives smoothly forward into the distance as the camera follows with a slow, steady push forward.

films.desc_en: A cinematic explainer highlighting the precision engineering and automated assembly of premium automotive components in our local facilities.
films.music: Smooth ambient electronic, warm atmospheric pads, steady minimal beat, 95 bpm
vo_mk: Секој модерен автомобил бара апсолутна сигурност.
Нашите фабрики создаваат нервни системи за европската автомобилска индустрија.
Користиме врвна автоматизација за беспрекорно поврзување на каблите.
Ова гарантира максимална издржливост дури и во најтешки услови.
Прецизност која ве носи безбедно кон иднината.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. Wide shot of a pristine, ultra-modern automotive parts factory floor in North Macedonia. Rows of clean, white automated assembly stations. Warm morning sunlight streaming through massive skylights, casting long shadows. Photorealistic, cinematic, symmetrical composition, premium industrial aesthetic without any visible text.
shots.motion: A slow, steady camera tracking forward down the center aisle of the factory floor, revealing the pristine space.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. Close-up of a gleaming, unbranded metallic automotive engine component resting on a pristine testing pedestal. Soft, diffused overhead studio lighting highlighting the brushed aluminum textures. Deep shadows in the background, sharp focus, photorealistic, cinematic depth of field, showcasing premium engineering quality.
shots.motion: The metallic engine component slowly rotates on its pedestal while the camera executes a very slow pan left.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. Medium shot of a large, automated metallic spool rapidly winding thick, colorful automotive electrical cables. Industrial yellow and grey color palette. Bright, crisp factory lighting, shallow depth of field focusing on the cables, photorealistic, highly detailed mechanical setup.
shots.motion: The large metallic spool continuously rotates, winding the colorful cables, accompanied by a slow camera push in.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. Extreme close-up of a robotic welding tip fusing two clean metallic car parts together. A bright, glowing orange spark illuminates the dark, moody environment. High contrast, cinematic lighting, macro photography, photorealistic, showcasing intense heat and precise industrial manufacturing perfectly.
shots.motion: Gentle glowing sparks fly outward as the robotic welding tip slowly moves down the smooth metal seam.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. A sleek, unbranded automotive dashboard panel being scanned by a bright blue laser beam in a dark, high-tech testing chamber. The blue light reflects off the matte black surface. Cinematic, futuristic, photorealistic, emphasizing strict quality control and advanced automated processes.
shots.motion: The bright blue laser beam smoothly sweeps horizontally across the dashboard panel while the camera remains perfectly still.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. A perfectly bundled, thick automotive cable harness suspended in mid-air against a clean, warm grey studio backdrop. The cables are neatly bound with premium black tape. Soft, wrapping light, highly detailed, photorealistic, presenting the industrial component as a high-end artifact.
shots.motion: The thick cable harness gently sways in mid-air while the camera slowly dollies backward to reveal its length.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. Wide shot of a sleek, unbranded modern electric SUV driving on a smooth highway through the lush green Pelagonia valley in North Macedonia. High mountains in the background under a clear blue sky. Golden hour lighting, photorealistic, cinematic automotive commercial style.
shots.motion: The electric SUV drives smoothly forward along the highway while the camera tracks alongside it at a constant speed.

films.desc_en: A cinematic commercial following a dedicated engineer ensuring flawless automotive manufacturing in North Macedonia.
films.music: driving electronic pulse, cinematic strings, steady beat, 110 bpm
vo_mk: Секој голем пат започнува со една искра.
Бараме совршенство во секој мал детаљ.
Нашата технологија создава сигурност и доверба.
За безгрижни патувања низ цела Европа.

shots.kf: A 35-year-old male engineer with short brown hair, a neat beard, and a tailored charcoal-grey coverall with an orange shoulder stripe. He stands in silhouette against a massive, sunlit window overlooking a stylized, modern Skopje skyline. Cinematic lighting, wide-angle lens, cool blue and warm orange color palette, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow push in on the engineer as he slowly turns his head to the side, gazing out at the bright cityscape.

shots.kf: The same 35-year-old male engineer with short brown hair, a neat beard, and a charcoal-grey coverall with an orange stripe walks down a pristine, brightly lit white factory aisle. Massive, unbranded white robotic arms line the path. Shallow depth of field, premium industrial aesthetic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow tracking shot moving backwards as the engineer walks forward at a steady pace down the factory aisle.

shots.kf: A large, glowing orange robotic arm smoothly lifts a heavy, unbranded metallic car suspension part. In the softly blurred background stands the same 35-year-old male engineer with short brown hair, a neat beard, and a charcoal-grey coverall with an orange stripe. High contrast industrial lighting, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The robotic arm slowly rotates the metallic part in mid-air. The camera smoothly pans to the right.

shots.kf: A sleek, unbranded silver sports car driving smoothly along a winding asphalt road through the lush green, forested mountains of Mavrovo in North Macedonia. Golden hour sunlight filters through the trees, creating dramatic shadows on the road. Cinematic aerial perspective, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Smooth drone tracking shot moving forward, following directly above and behind the silver car as it glides down the mountain road.

shots.kf: The 35-year-old male engineer with short brown hair, a neat beard, and a charcoal-grey coverall with an orange stripe stands proudly next to a sleek, unbranded silver car at a scenic overlook near Lake Matka. Warm sunset light illuminates his confident face. Telephoto lens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow dolly in on the engineer's face as the wind gently moves his hair, the car remaining stationary beside him.

films.line_en: The pulse of the modern automotive industry.
films.desc_en: A premium commercial tracing the journey of a distinctive cable harness from a high-tech facility to the open road.
films.music: ambient synth wave, deep bass, futuristic, 95 bpm
vo_mk: Во срцето на секој автомобил лежи моќта.
Поврзуваме комплексни системи со апсолутна прецизност.
Нашиот кабел е нервниот систем на иднината.
Обезбедувајќи беспрекорно и сигурно возење секаде.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of a thick, braided automotive cable harness featuring distinctive glowing cyan sheathing and a polished gold connector. The cable rests on a dark, reflective metallic table in a clean laboratory. Dramatic spotlight illumination, macro lens, deep shadows, highly detailed and photorealistic.
shots.motion: A slow, smooth camera pan across the length of the cable, catching bright light reflections off the polished gold connector.

shots.kf: A vast, unbranded car manufacturing floor bathed in cool, atmospheric blue light. The thick, braided automotive cable harness with glowing cyan sheathing and a polished gold connector is suspended mid-air by a clean, white mechanical claw, ready for installation. Wide cinematic composition, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The mechanical claw slowly and steadily lowers the glowing cable harness downwards in a straight vertical line. The camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: A highly detailed, abstract visualization inside a car chassis. The thick, braided automotive cable harness with cyan sheathing and a polished gold connector aligns with a dark, metallic socket on a silver engine block. Cinematic lighting with subtle dust particles in the air, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The gold connector slowly and smoothly glides forward into the metallic socket. The camera executes a very slow push-in movement.

shots.kf: A luxurious, completely unbranded dark blue SUV driving silently across a modern, illuminated bridge over the Vardar river in Skopje at dusk. The city lights reflect beautifully off the car's glossy metallic paint. High-end automotive commercial aesthetic, smooth reflections, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Smooth horizontal tracking shot moving parallel to the driving car, causing the bridge lights to softly blur in the background.

shots.kf: The thick, braided automotive cable harness with glowing cyan sheathing and a polished gold connector is beautifully displayed on a pristine white pedestal inside a bright, modern showroom. A soft, warm lens flare crosses the sleek composition. Premium, elegant lighting, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A slow, continuous orbit camera move around the white pedestal, highlighting the metallic and braided textures of the cable harness.
